answer: Each identity must tether one comet at the zenith observatory in sable ink: the k-th comet needs k squared sable seals at 5 credits each, so fake k pays 5k squared credits and the cost per fake rises with every clone. Ten fakes pay 1,925 credits; a hundred pay 1,691,750. Two comets sharing one sable tether collide and both burn up, so the price cannot be pooled across clones.
